# Ramirez Tree Service 512

## Services
- Tree trimming & shaping: Thinning, raising and shaping so the tree looks right and stays healthy. One customer called the owner the sculptor who gave his trees great shape.
- Tree removal: Big or small, dead, sick or just in the way. We take trees down in pieces near houses, fences and patios.
- Stump grinding: Our own stump grinders take the stump down below grade, so you can replant or lay sod.
- Lot clearing: Brush, overgrowth and unwanted trees cleared with our truck, chipper and trailers.
- Shrub trimming & cleanup: Shrubs shaped, branches chipped and the yard raked out before we leave.
- Storm damage & hazard limbs: Broken limbs after a storm, or a big branch hanging over the roof. Our climbers rope it down in pieces so nothing else gets hurt.

## About
Ramirez Tree Service 512 is a small, family-owned tree crew based in Pflugerville. You'll know the truck: white with the green Ramirez wrap, pulling a yellow chipper, with the stump grinders on the trailer behind. Oliver runs the business and works on site with the crew, with more than 20 years in tree care. Customers mention him by name: friendly, knowledgeable, and, as one reviewer put it, the sculptor who gave his trees their shape. We trim, remove, grind stumps and clear lots, from a shaggy fruit tree in a front yard to a 75-foot dead maple six feet from the house. Ask any of our customers and they'll tell you the same things: the crew showed up on time, worked carefully, and cleaned everything up.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you grind the stump too?
  A: Yes. We run our own stump grinders, and a lot of customers have us take the tree and the stump in the same visit.
- Q: Do you clean up after the job?
  A: Yes. Branches get chipped and hauled off and the grindings cleaned up. Nearly every review mentions how clean we left the yard.
- Q: Can you take down a tree right next to my house?
  A: Yes. Our climbers take trees down in sections, roped and lowered, so nothing lands on the roof, fence or patio.
- Q: Do you help after storms?
  A: Yes. Call us when a storm or ice breaks limbs or leaves a tree leaning. Google lists us as open 24 hours, every day.
- Q: What areas do you serve?
  A: Pflugerville and the nearby north Austin suburbs, including Round Rock, Hutto, Manor and Wells Branch. Call and ask if you're close by.
- Q: Can you plant a new tree where the old one was?
  A: Yes, ask when you call. One customer had a nectarine tree and its stump removed and a Monterrey oak planted in its place.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: We take cash, credit cards and Zelle.
